desc: Someone puts Christmas cards with a photo into green envelopes.
Michael and Dwight try to get the big Christmas tree through the doors.
Michael and Dwight set up a Christmas tree whose top pokes through the ceiling.
Michael, with a big smile, stands next to the tree in front of the window decorated with gold and red Christmas ornaments.
Kevin cut off the top of the Christmas tree.
Dwight vacuums up needles under the Christmas tree.
Jim holds up an old black-and-white photo, smiling.
A person counts money in their hand and places it on the counter near the notebook.
Michael wearing a Santa hat and beard, brings Angela's and Phyllis's heads together.
Kevin and Oscar in Christmas ties try to lift a desk in the office.
Dwight in an elf costume with a green hat places a present under the Christmas tree.
A shot of a decorated Christmas tree that barely lights up.
Dwight in an elf costume with pointy ears pulls a plastic-wrapped item out from under the Christmas tree.
Dwight throws a small christmas present wrapped in red paper.
Phyllis in a floral shirt and cream sweater vest with poinsettia, smiles.
Michael in a Santa hat looks alarmed as he holds up his hand wearing a pink oven mitt.
Michael exits the room tossing his Santa hat onto the sofa.
Angela in a sweater with a Santa pin cries.
Ryan holds up a pink floral name plate.
A nighttime office building with Christmas lights and falling snow.
Michael pulls the ears off Dwight, who is in an elf costume, and throws them at his face.
Dwight shoots at a silhouette target with a paintball gun.
Michael in a Santa hat, buys a lot of drinks at the store.
A colorful disco light ball sits on a stereo system in an office decorated for Christmas.
Kevin stands in a small foot spa tub in the office.
Dwight in an elf costume holds a teapot spout up to his own nose.
Michael in a Santa hat photographs two men sitting on the sofa.
Four people knock their shot glasses against the counter and drink up.
Jim tucks a white envelope into the back pocket of his pants.
A man jumps onto the back of Michael, who is wearing a Santa hat, and they take a picture together.
Kevin in headphones grimaces up close, while Darryl in the background laughs and moves his hand up and down.
A man wearing a white lampshade on his head walks into the room.
A man sleeps at his desk with garland around his neck, as someone sprays something on his head.
Angela smashes Christmas ornaments in anger outside in the falling snow.
A group of people exit the office decorated for Christmas.
A group of people throw snowballs at each other in a snowy parking lot.
